tables.title: Present Simple (المضارع البسيط)
rows: The brain does not remember positive experiences.
Does the brain remember negative experiences?
tables.explanation: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحقائق والعادات الثابتة. نضيف s/es للفعل مع he/she/it.
tables.examples: The brain remembers negative experiences. / Exercise improves health.

tables.title: Present Progressive (المضارع المستمر)
tables.explanation: نستخدم المضارع المستمر للأحداث الجارية الآن أو الفترات المؤقتة.
tables.examples: He is travelling with Liam. / They are discussing differences.

tables.title: Past Simple (الماضي البسيط)
rows: They bought a house last year.
They did not buy a car.
Did they buy a house last year?
tables.explanation: نستخدم الماضي البسيط للأحداث التي وقعت وانتهت في الماضي.
tables.examples: They bought a house last year. / He lived in London.

tables.title: Past Continuous (الماضي المستمر)
rows: She was having lunch when her friends came.
Was she having lunch when her friends came?
tables.explanation: نستخدم الماضي المستمر للأحداث المستمرة في الماضي، خاصة عندما يقطعها حدث آخر.
tables.examples: Sarah hurt her ankle while she was running. / Leila was having lunch when her friends came.

tables.title: Present Perfect (المضارع التام)
rows: She has worked here for three years.
Has she worked here for three years?
tables.explanation: نستخدم المضارع التام للأحداث التي بدأت في الماضي واستمرت حتى الآن.
tables.examples: She has been working there for three years. / They haven't visited the museum since 2014.

tables.title: Demonstratives (أسماء الإشارة)
rows: This was such an interesting experience.
Are those your shoes over there?
tables.explanation: أسماء الإشارة تستخدم للإشارة إلى الأشياء حسب القرب والبعد والمفرد والجمع.
tables.examples: This was such an interesting experience. / Are those your shoes?

tables.title: Imperatives (صيغة الأمر)
tables.explanation: صيغة الأمر تستخدم للأمر أو الطلب أو النصيحة. للنفي نستخدم Don't + الفعل في المصدر.
tables.examples: Don't run in the corridors! / Watch out! You are driving very fast.

tables.title: Question Words (أدوات الاستفهام)
rows: When did they buy a house?
How long has she been working there?
How often do you ride your bike?
tables.explanation: أدوات الاستفهام توضع في بداية السؤال ويتبعها الفعل المساعد ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل الرئيسي.
tables.examples: Where does he live? / When did they buy a house? / Who is Liam?

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر)
rows: مكان محدد / وقت محدد / ينظر إلى
at school, at 5 o'clock, look at
for three years, apply for a job
to make communication easier, wanted to go
tables.explanation: حروف الجر تأتي قبل الاسم أو الضمير ولها استخدامات متعددة حسب السياق.
tables.examples: He lives in London. / She has been working there for three years. / They are talking about differences.

tables.title: Conjunctions (أدوات الربط)
rows: He was tired, so he slept.
He got the job because of his mother's advice.
Although he was tired, he continued.
tables.explanation: أدوات الربط تستخدم لربط الجمل أو الكلمات.
tables.examples: He is nice but impatient. / He was tired, so he slept.

tables.title: Word Choice (اختيار الكلمة المناسبة)
rows: We have no choice but to study.
She has to pay a fine.
tables.explanation: اختيار الكلمة المناسبة يعتمد على موقعها في الجملة (اسم، فعل، صفة).
tables.examples: She has to pay a fine. / A good diet is beneficial. / The police discovered the cause.
